integrity: The proof independently classifies all Birkhoff-James pairs by whether the first unit vector is a smooth edge point or a vertex, and computes the minimum reverse support-functional residual. For 4m-gons the maximum residual is tan(pi/N) and is attained by a vertex/perpendicular-edge-midpoint pair; for 4m+2-gons every residual is zero. The bundled enumeration is supplementary to the analytic proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats two-dimensional Banach spaces whose unit balls are Euclidean regular even polygons. It does not determine the optimal C-approximate symmetry parameter for arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons. The N congruent to 2 modulo 4 zero branch is qualitatively known from exact Birkhoff-James symmetry; the new quantitative content is the unified phase law and the sharp positive defect for all regular 4m-gons.
title: Sharp \(C\)-approximate Birkhoff symmetry of regular even polygonal planes
